# Ullishtja Agroturizem

> Traditional Albanian restaurant and agritourism venue in Spitalle, Durrës, Albania, set among olive trees. Farm-to-table cooking from family recipes, garden seating, and space for family celebrations and events of up to about 60 guests. Open every day, 11:00–22:00. Founded in 2021.

- Address: Rruga Syri i Detit, Rruga 2 Batot, Spitalle, 2001 Durrës, Albania
- Map: https://maps.google.com/?q=41.340278,19.433569+(Ullishtja+Agroturizem)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +355 68 409 0405 (reservations are made by phone or WhatsApp: https://wa.me/355684090405)
- Email: hi@ullishtja-agroturizem.com
- Prices are in Albanian lek (ALL). Free parking on site. Vegetarian dishes are marked on the menu.
